item.description:
Built-in runtime for Cursor, Pi and Factory Droid, plus calmer connections, for Controller on Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Android.
- Cursor: Controller now runs Cursor's SDK in its own built-in JavaScript runtime, and each Cursor chat runs in its own process, so a crash in one chat no longer stops your other Cursor chats. Download the Cursor SDK once from Settings → Harnesses; existing Cursor accounts show how until it is installed. - Pi and Factory Droid no longer need Node. If Pi is not already installed, Settings → Harnesses offers Download Pi. - Fixed Cursor and Pi chats occasionally failing to start with an "in use" message when another chat stopped at the same moment. - Connect: a Mac that stays unreachable is shown as offline and checked quietly in the background instead of reconnecting over and over. It is reached right away when it comes back, and sending work to it connects at once. - Connect: iPhones, iPads and Macs connected to a busy Mac no longer drop and reconnect every few seconds. - Connect: long conversations open faster on your other devices because their history is compressed.
Also includes the fixes prepared for build 75: messages are no longer refused after a brief problem saving the workspace, updates Controller finds start downloading reliably, and agents can install a Controller update when you ask them to.

Reliability update for Controller on Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Android.
- Remote conversations: messages sent from another device are saved before delivery and checked again after a reconnect, so a dropped connection no longer loses or duplicates a prompt. - Connect: trusted workspaces stay connected when a host's address changes, and long repository histories load page by page. - Files: remote images, videos and documents share a storage budget per device. Files you are viewing are kept while older ones are cleared, and a full disk now shows a clear message. - Checkpoints: rolling back records its progress first, so an interrupted rollback can finish when Controller next opens. - Stability: Controller limits how much unsaved work can build up under heavy load, and catches up long-running threads from what is already saved. - Memory: saving memory notes is journaled, so an interrupted save is finished or undone the next time it runs. - Transcripts: very large messages no longer stall the window while they are formatted.

# Controller 1.0.51 (73)
- Switch provider accounts between turns while keeping the conversation’s context, including on Android. - Fork conversations across providers and bring completed work back into the parent conversation. - Restore work with Git checkpoints and safer rollback recovery. - Manage queued messages and answer pending requests more reliably across devices. - Keep stopped work, expired approvals, and private secret requests in the correct state after interruptions or relaunches. - Show elapsed time for completed plan steps on iPhone and iPad. - Improve reliability when reconnecting to native provider sessions and recovering saved conversations.
